Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the initial web results and, using a flawed “first-listed-director” heuristic, treated Anthony Asquith as the director of “Gently My Songs Entreat,” despite the Wikipedia result clearly indicating the 1933 film (Leise flehen meine Lieder) was directed by Willi Forst. This misidentification redirected the task toward Asquith’s birthplace instead of the correct director Willi Forst’s birthplace (Vienna, Austria-Hungary), leading the solution astray.
